dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Visible as series of discrete white spots along the lateral edges of the folded primaries, providing high contrast against the dark grey ground color.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A distinct, circular to oval-shaped patch of rufous/orange plumage located on the crown extending toward the nape.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A clear and distinct color boundary where the rufous crown patch and surrounding dark grey crown plumage transition to a uniform grey mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: The rectrices exhibit high-contrast, transverse white-and-black barring extending the length of the visible tail.
